body:
CHANGELOG updated in GoblinFoxDragon: S412-09: mob-drop tables now roll each item's real drop_chance independently (RollDropsFor) instead of always dropping the whole table; dropsForMob wired to it. Live-verified 6/6 vs 0/6 against a forced 0% test item. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)
